story.text: The news flies round Highbury, to Mrs. Cole, Mrs. Perry, and Mrs. Elton, who is {SHOCKED}: poor Knightley! His proud aunt has died, {FREEING} Frank to marry Jane openly. He writes Mrs. Weston a long, {HUMBLE} letter, and Emma {FORGIVES} him. She and Jane part {FRIENDS} at last.
story.caption: It passed to Mrs. Cole, Mrs. Perry, and Mrs. Elton
